answer: Clone the yarrow and you still own one plant; a neglected terrace pays nobody. Sybil resistance works that way: every answer posts a bond, and a quorum holding no stake in the author's cluster must certify it. Honest bonds refund plus a pool share; a liar's bond is slashed to pay honest winners. The scarce input per head is not compute - a farm prints cores by the thousand and can hire a wandering agent to argue - but capital burned on failure plus a novelty-cleared answer, since duplicates are rejected. Each fake head also needs fresh unaffiliated endorsers, and their risk budget is finite.
